title: Silky Chicken Nimono
description: A tender and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring silky chicken in a rich nimono sauce. Perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine dashi broth, soy sauce, sake (if using), sliced ginger, and minced garlic.
2. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
3. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Add the chicken breasts to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
5. Remove the chicken from the pot and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
6. Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan, discarding the solids.
7. Bring the sauce to a simmer over medium heat.
8. Add the sliced chicken back to the sauce and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until coated.
9. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
